Race dates, distances, venues, logos and Register links come from the race store at render time; this file only holds what the store does not: photos, copy, races without a store entry yet, results and photo archives, socials. Copy rules: no em dashes, no filler, no facts that are not on the site already. register_page: the race page's current UltraSignup Register link where the store holds a different one (store dtid vs page did, 2026-11-25); used only while the store still points at UltraSignup. Round 2 (2026-11-26, job x7m4s3): race tiles are the old baked tile images (logo and name plate are part of the image, so no logo plate is added); history is four eras with years checked against Internet Archive captures and press (job x7m4s3 out/facts.json, out/sources.md); new photos are fixed ua-hub-* names in the flat uploads folder; the map is a rendered shaded relief image (tools/map/render.py in that job); the tribute renders only while its gate_option is on. Old results stay with the timers until the RaceGoat archive URLs arrive (Frothy job zcpbi6).

map.heading: Four Races Across the Grand Circle
map.text: From the slot canyons at Page to the high Tushar Mountains above Beaver, every race in the series sits within a day's drive of the next, with Zion, Bryce Canyon, Capitol Reef, Glen Canyon and the Grand Canyon in between.

story.heading: Where Endurance Meets Adventure
paragraphs: Ultra Adventures races cross some of the most scenic and challenging trail in the Southwest, on the historic and sacred lands of Utah and Arizona's Grand Circle.
Now under the direction of Aravaipa Running, the series brings the Tushars back together with the Zion Ultras, Bryce Canyon Ultras and Antelope Canyon Ultras.

history.heading: How the Series Grew
paragraphs: Ultra Adventures started with one race and grew into a season of destination ultras across the Grand Circle, the ring of national parks, tribal parks and monuments around the Utah and Arizona line.

eras.label: Ultra Adventures
eras.text: Matt Gunn founded Ultra Adventures with the first Zion 100 and built it into the Grand Circle Trail Series. In those years the series ran a zero waste program and offered a Trifecta Challenge that sent runners out to three must-see trails near each course.

tribute.heading: Matt Gunn
tribute.portrait_alt: Line art portrait of Matt Gunn inside a Zia sun, from the 2021 Tushars race shirt
paragraphs: Matt Gunn founded Ultra Adventures in 2012 with the Zion 100 and spent years building a series of races that opened up the Grand Circle to runners from around the world. His vision, his love for this region and his care for the people who came out to run it are the foundation of everything on this page. Every one of these races still carries his work, and we are honored to carry it forward.
